messages.subject: For Christel Heydemann | Digital infrastructure, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Orange Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Christel Heydemann, Chief Executive Officer.

Orange's strategy across connectivity, AI and digital services requires disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and operating businesses. That interface closely matches the work I lead today in a complex emerging-market environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Orange's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Orange.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
